answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), validated through a trusted remote-attestation chain and hardware-backed key. A copied virtual machine cannot reproduce the authorized measurement or forge its platform identity; creating another accepted identity requires provisioning a distinct physical TEE, making silicon purchase—not VM duplication—the scarce resource. Thus raven, tundra, and nebula instances resist Sybil inflation.
